theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_imc_isIntegerMultiplicity_of_rectifiable
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Γ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (θ : Euclid P → ℝ) (ζ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n), MeasurableSet M → CountablyRectifiable n M → Measurable θ → StronglyMeasurable ζ → (∀ x ∈ M, 0 < θ x) → ∫⁻ x in M, ENNReal.ofReal (θ x) ∂μHE[n] < ∞ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, Γ ω = ∫ x in M, θ x * ζ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μHE[n]) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q ∧ IsUnitOrientationOf (ζ x) Q ∧ ∃ m : ℕ, θ x = m) → IsIntegerMultiplicity Γ
